name: pixel-patrol
description: Pixel Patrol — GDPR drift watchdog. npm workspaces: one lockfile, one copy of the fingerprint types.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pixel-patrol/shared && npm run build --workspace pixel-patrol-crawler && npm run build --workspace pixel-patrol-agent && npm run build --workspace pixel-patrol-demo-sites
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @pixel-patrol/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace pixel-patrol-crawler && npm run typecheck --workspace pixel-patrol-agent && npm run typecheck --workspace pixel-patrol-demo-sites
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @pixel-patrol/shared && npm run test --workspace pixel-patrol-crawler && npm run test --workspace pixel-patrol-agent && npm run test --workspace pixel-patrol-demo-sites
